title: Bubba's Discs, Tricks, Trims, and Iron
description: A little misc pack with new lighter iron things, new disc textures, new keys, and new trims!
body:
This is a tiny pack with:
Discs - Music discs are now more shiny and the C418 discs have more modern textures
Tricks - New trial key and breeze rod/charge textures
Trims - New armor trim item designs and lighter rib and silence trims
Iron - Updates some block textures made with iron to be white instead of dark-grey
